meta.name: add-atomic-chat-tool
meta.description: Add Atomic Chat MCP server so the container agent can call local models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app via its OpenAI-compatible API.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让容器代理调用本地大模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让容器中的智能体调用本地运行的大模型
copy.tagline_en: Enable your container agent to call local AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your containerized agent to use local AI models

howto.what: Claude 仍是主控,但可以把活交给本地 Atomic Chat 桌面应用里运行的模型:先列出当前可用模型,再把提示发给指定模型并取回回答。
howto.when: 装上并注册后在容器 agent 中生效。当你要求用 Atomic Chat 或本地模型处理事情(例如让它回答一个问题)时,Claude 会先列出模型再生成回答。

say.text: 用 atomic chat 告诉我法国的首都是哪里
say.note: 会先列模型再用某个模型回答

say.text: 列出 atomic chat 里现在可用的模型
say.note: 返回模型 ID 列表,便于后面指定

howto.what_en: Claude stays the orchestrator but can offload work to local models running in the Atomic Chat desktop app: it lists available models and sends a prompt to a chosen model, returning the response.
howto.when_en: Takes effect once installed and registered. Ask for work via Atomic Chat or a local model (e.g. a question to answer) and Claude lists models first, then generates.

say_en.text: use atomic chat to tell me the capital of France
say_en.note: Lists models, then generates a reply

say_en.text: use atomic_chat_generate with llama3.2-3b-instruct to answer: what is MCP
say_en.note: Generates with the named model ID

say_en.text: list the models available in atomic chat
say_en.note: Returns model IDs to pick from
